description: What alcohol licenses does this business hold or has it held? Returns TABC licenses with type, trade name, status and issue, status-change and expiration dates, each with how it was linked to the entity and the link's confidence, and any TABC Credit Law Delinquent List appearances (unpaid wholesaler credit). Texas only; businesses registered with the Texas Comptroller or TABC, refreshed nightly from Texas state datasets. Example: {"entity_id": "32057926266", "active_only": true}.

active_only.description: Only licenses whose primary status is Active. Default false.

entity_id.description: entity_id from resolve_business (11-digit Texas taxpayer number), or a 10-digit SOS file number.

include_affiliates.description: Also include affiliated entities (likely common control, confidence >= 0.5). Default false.

name: get_licenses
title: Alcohol licenses of a Texas business
